about.title: About
about.label: Profile
about.intro: I'm Ethan — a full-stack developer from Malaysia, finishing a degree in Information Systems while building software for real clients.
story: I started where most developers start — websites — and kept going down the stack: Laravel back-ends, MySQL schemas, Redis caches, AWS deploys, and once, an entire club management system in x86 assembly.
Most of what I've shipped since lives behind a login: an ERP, a service-ticket CRM, an SMS platform. Unglamorous, load-bearing software. That's the work I like most.
Now I'm pointing the same habits at AI — retrieval pipelines, agent workflows, fine-tuning, and models small enough to run on a laptop with no internet.
